subject: general
question: To which of the following states do 'Kajali Paintings’, in which no brush is used, traditionally belong?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rajasthan.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kajali** is an ancient form of painting originating from Rajasthan.
 
• This art is more prominent in the eastern part of the state.
 
• The word ‘kajali’ is derived from ‘kajal’ meaning carbon black.
 
• Apart from the grey shade imparted by carbon black, other colours have also been incorporated into this painting.
 
• **No brushes are used in Kajali painting. **
 
• The only tools used are **hand and cloth.**
 
• Carbon black obtained from burning** oil lamps is spread on paper or cloth using a piece of paper**.
